newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Xpress sees Q3 beating expectations.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Xpress sees Q3 beating expectations.

text.p: U.S. Xpress Enterprises Inc Wednesday said it expects results for its fiscal third quarter ending December 31, 1996 to exceed analysts' expectations of 15 to 16 cents per share.

Earnings in the quarter ending December 30, 1995 were $551,000, or five cents per common share. Earnings in the quarter ending September 30, 1996 were $2.7 million or 23 cents per share, the firm said.
The expectations are based on cost reductions, improved tractor utilization and continuing strong freight demand, the company said.
U.S. Xpress is a national truckload carrier and logistics service that specializes in serving air cargo shippers.
